description:
🎧 Explore a great way to find podcast shows and episodes based on what you’re looking for.
Ask about any topic, idea, or show, and get relevant podcasts and specific episodes 🔍

✨ With Podcast App in ChatGPT you can:

	•	🔍 Search for podcasts by topic, interest, or question
	•	🎙️ Find specific episodes that cover what you want to explore
	•	📋 Explore episodes within a podcast on specific themes

defaultPrompt: Provide podcast episodes about World War II
